supplyFacts.source_quote: Groq’s financials are still private for now, but its pivot puts the company directly inside Nvidia’s AI infrastructure ecosystem. That’s not exactly a unique relationship among neoclouds today. Nvidia supplies the GPUs powering clouds from CoreWeave , Lambda, and Nebius, while also investing billions into some of those companies as they race to build more capacity.
